reference_identity: Mini V3 3.12.0.3422 software-synth recording; not physical hardware

rate_conversion.input: scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser beta 8.6, integer Q1.15 reconstruction; default taps: 41 (2x), 81 (4x)
rate_conversion.output: scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser beta 8.6, anti-alias decimation to 48 kHz; default taps: 41 (2x), 81 (4x)
rate_conversion.coefficients: g/k ROMs generated at the actual ladder factor; per-frame ROM values held across reconstructed subframes
rate_conversion.ladder_arithmetic: fixed-point LadderFx, one update per internal-rate sample

production_2x_sample_hold.scope: small-signal filter response, separate from the Mini V3 sound-fidelity score

reconstructed_2x.scope: small-signal filter response, separate from the Mini V3 sound-fidelity score

reconstructed_4x.scope: small-signal filter response, separate from the Mini V3 sound-fidelity score

pulse479_scope: model-only challenger; deliberately absent from WAVE_CODE and unsupported by RTL
wrong_then_right: Initial red harness run refused during collection because model/filter_rate_chain.py did not exist; after implementation all five ground-truth tests passed.

model_screen.meaning: screen only; passing justifies a separately verified RTL prototype, not release

Pitch.tolerance_basis: cents; fixed screening limit for this frozen software-synth patch

Harmonic shape.tolerance_basis: dB per measured partial; fixed screening limit

Foldback energy.tolerance_basis: dB excess alias energy above the reference; cleaner output is not penalized

Envelope attack.tolerance_basis: ms; fixed limit above the 5 ms RMS measurement hop

Envelope release.tolerance_basis: ms; fixed 10% of the measured reference T20

Gain.tolerance_basis: dB; fixed half/double amplitude screening range

wrong_then_right.accepted: smooth-waveform transient detector: 0 events; injected-click control: 5 events

discarded.reason: host automation block size was not pinned to the 16-sample qualification setting

wrong_then_right.discarded: saw transient detector: 2172 events from waveform edges; detector domain invalid for a saw

pulse29.note: Full sound comparison uses the fixed integer model; a separate short M5A stimulus verifies the selected configuration through SPI to I2S.
